chief_complaint: Recent acute non‑ST‑segment elevation myocardial infarction (NSTEMI)
history_of_present_illness: The patient is a 62‑year‑old male who suffered an acute NSTEMI on 2024‑07‑31, followed by documentation of a prior myocardial infarction on 2024‑08‑11 and abnormal cardiac imaging on 2024‑08‑05. Since late 2023 he has been diagnosed with type 2 diabetes, metabolic syndrome, and obesity. Hypertriglyceridemia was noted in October 2024. He also has chronic anemia, ongoing stress, and chronic sinusitis. Despite multiple high‑risk cardiovascular conditions, only diphenhydramine is recorded as a current medication. Recent visits have focused on retinal imaging for diabetic eye screening, but vital signs, lipid panels, and renal function are missing.
